# oci-hosted (oci hosted) at http://gateway.test/gw
# set ARTIFACT_GATEWAY_TOKEN to a credential with access to this repository

## sign in
printf '%s' "$ARTIFACT_GATEWAY_TOKEN" | docker login gateway.test --username ci --password-stdin

## pull
docker pull gateway.test/gw/oci-hosted/<image>:<tag>

## push
docker tag <local-image>:<tag> gateway.test/gw/oci-hosted/<image>:<tag>
docker push gateway.test/gw/oci-hosted/<image>:<tag>
